Tiny Tapeout boards at fpgas.online

This is a community-run instance of Tiny Tapeout hardware, hosted at Welland, South Australia. Anyone can drive these boards — no login required. Be nice: others may be driving the same board at the same time.

How this works

Each board sits on a Raspberry Pi with a camera. The Commander you see is the fpgas.online fork of Tiny Tapeout's Commander app, talking to the board's RP2040 over a WebSocket bridge. Docs →

A community-run Tiny Tapeout hardware instance hosted by fpgas.online at Welland, South Australia — not operated by Tiny Tapeout Ltd. Source on GitHub · fpgas.online
